name: wpsafemode/dev
description: Development tooling only. The shipped ZIP has no dependencies.
_comment_compat: phpstan is not in the original M0 plan. It stands in for the php:8.0-cli container where Docker is unavailable: phpstan.neon.dist pins phpVersion to 80000, so readonly properties, enums, never, first-class callables and array_is_list() are reported regardless of the developer's local PHP. Verified against a probe file: readonly is a parse error at 80000 and clean at 80100, and array_is_list() reports 'Function not found'. Run it in CI whether or not the container is available. PHPCompatibility was tried first and removed — its stable release predates 8.1 and passed code using both of the above.
